proof_body:
by
  intro a b L hb hinf h
  refine Metric.tendsto_atTop.2 fun ε hε => ?_
  obtain ⟨N1, hN1⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.1 h (ε / 2) (by positivity)
  obtain ⟨N2, hN2⟩ := Filter.tendsto_atTop_atTop.1 hinf 1
  obtain ⟨N, hNdef⟩ : ∃ N, N = max N1 N2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hbN : 0 < b N := by
    have h1 := hN2 N (hNdef ▸ le_max_right _ _)
    linarith
  have hstep : ∀ n, N ≤ n → |(a (n + 1) - L * b (n + 1)) - (a n - L * b n)| ≤ ε / 2 * (b (n + 1) - b n) := by
    intro n hn
    have hd : 0 < b (n + 1) - b n := sub_pos.2 (hb (Nat.lt_succ_self n))
    have hq := hN1 n ((le_max_left N1 N2).trans (hNdef ▸ hn))
    rw [Real.dist_eq] at hq
    have e : (a (n + 1) - L * b (n + 1)) - (a n - L * b n) = ((a (n + 1) - a n) / (b (n + 1) - b n) - L) * (b (n + 1) - b n) := by
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [e, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hd]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hq.le hd.le
  have hsum : ∀ n, N ≤ n → |(a n - L * b n) - (a N - L * b N)| ≤ ε / 2 * (b n - b N) := by
    intro n hn
    induction n, hn using Nat.le_induction with
    | base => simp
    | succ n hn ih =>
      have h1 := hstep n hn
      have t := abs_add_le ((a (n + 1) - L * b (n + 1)) - (a n - L * b n)) ((a n - L * b n) - (a N - L * b N))
      have e2 : (a (n + 1) - L * b (n + 1)) - (a n - L * b n) + ((a n - L * b n) - (a N - L * b N)) = (a (n + 1) - L * b (n + 1)) - (a N - L * b N) := by ring
      rw [e2] at t
      have e3 : ε / 2 * (b (n + 1) - b n) + ε / 2 * (b n - b N) = ε / 2 * (b (n + 1) - b N) := by ring
      linarith
  obtain ⟨N3, hN3⟩ := Filter.tendsto_atTop_atTop.1 hinf (2 * |a N - L * b N| / ε + 1)
  refine ⟨max N N3, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  have hnN : N ≤ n := le_of_max_le_left hn
  have hbn : 0 < b n := lt_of_lt_of_le hbN (hb.monotone hnN)
  have hM := hN3 n (le_of_max_le_right hn)
  have hM2 : 2 * |a N - L * b N| / ε < b n := by linarith
  rw [div_lt_iff₀ hε] at hM2
  have e4 : a n / b n - L = (a n - L * b n) / b n := by
    field_simp
  rw [Real.dist_eq, e4, abs_div, abs_of_pos hbn, div_lt_iff₀ hbn]
  have h5 := hsum n hnN
  have h6 : |a n - L * b n| ≤ |(a n - L * b n) - (a N - L * b N)| + |a N - L * b N| := by
    have h7 := abs_add_le ((a n - L * b n) - (a N - L * b N)) (a N - L * b N)
    rwa [sub_add_cancel] at h7
  have h8 : 0 < ε / 2 * b N := by positivity
  have e5 : ε / 2 * (b n - b N) = ε / 2 * b n - ε / 2 * b N := by ring
  nlinarith
target_source: ∀ (a b : ℕ → ℝ) (L : ℝ), StrictMono b → Filter.Tendsto b Filter.atTop Filter.atTop → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (a (n + 1) - a n) / (b (n + 1) - b n)) Filter.atTop (nhds L) → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => a n / b n) Filter.atTop (nhds L)
